auto_fix.title: Scanner baseline rescue can never match real ubs output: the ruling 'refuse only NEW findings' is implemented against a stub that has a different shape
auto_fix.fix: Normalise the location before building the signature. Strip the $ROOT prefix from HEAD lines and the $SCRATCH prefix from base lines, reducing both to repo-relative paths. For a bare locator line, take the preceding '[severity] rule: msg' line as the message. Build the signature from the de-duplicated DETAIL set only; do not reconcile against the summary counters, or reconcile per scanner module. Add a test that runs the REAL ubs, skipped only if ubs is absent, on a file with one pre-existing bash finding and one python finding, where the base and HEAD copies differ only in line shift. Reopen the FRICTIONS control until that test is green.

auto_fix.title: Scanner-baseline cases pass on a ubs stand-in that drops the GitHub-permalink suffix real ubs appends to every detail line, so the rescue matches nothing on real output
auto_fix.fix: Replace the content-mode mock with the real shape: `path:line` with no column for python, plus a ` (https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/blob/<sha>/<path>#L<line>)` suffix when cwd is inside a git repo and none outside one. Better still, commit a captured real-ubs transcript as the fixture. The gate side then has to strip the trailing ` (https://...#L\d+)` in sig_of, or run the baseline from a context with the same shape. Add a case where HEAD runs in a git repo and base does not, and assert rescue > 0.

auto_fix.title: Scanner pre-existing rescue never matches: real ubs prints absolute paths, and the baseline runs in a scratch dir
auto_fix.fix: Normalise the path before comparing: strip the "$PWD/" prefix from HEAD detail lines and the "$SCRATCH/" prefix from base detail lines (or key on the SCAN_FILES-relative path). Make the mock print absolute paths with no column so AC4b runs against the real shape. Also compare as a multiset (count each signature) instead of set membership: a bead that ADDS another identical finding would be rescued as pre-existing.

auto_fix.title: Rule 6 still accepts a landing record the closer hand-writes, and br close --transition-comment makes that a one-liner that skips close-gate
auto_fix.fix: Make rule 6 check the record's grammar, not just its prefix. Require the full close-gate shape, `^(GATE: (receipt|decided)|FRESH-VERIFY:|TRIAGE-CLOSE:) — <id> — .* (verified )?at <sha> by <actor> at <ISO ts>`, where <id> is the row's own id, <sha> resolves and is an ancestor of the staged commit, and <actor> is the row's assignee (for GATE: decided, a name on the Humans line or ac-tidy). A stronger option: close-gate appends a line to <git-common-dir>/ac-close-ledger (id, record sha256, HEAD) and rule 6 requires the record's hash to be in that ledger. Add a rule-6 test in which a bare 'GATE: receipt' comment is new in the commit and must FAIL.

auto_fix.title: Scanner baseline never matches on real ubs output — the extra ubs run is pure cost and never clears an existing finding
auto_fix.fix: Normalise both sides before matching: in sig_of, remove a trailing ' (https://...#L[0-9]+)' from msg, and make loc relative by removing the '$ROOT/' prefix (HEAD) and the '$SCRATCH/' prefix (base). Add a test fixture made from captured real ubs output (absolute path plus permalink), so the mock follows the real contract.

auto_fix.title: Roster ruling contradicts its own cited canon: agent-identity.md and coordinator.sh still say the name is read from the spawn response, and no canon defines the task_description filter
auto_fix.fix: Make agent-identity.md the one owner. Rewrite its spawn row and its SPEC-VIOLATION section to the registration-roster rule, including the exact resource and field and the run-id format. Delete the 'zero mcp__* tools' clause for the implementer. Replace coordinator.sh's --actor header with a pointer to that section. Better still, let coordinator.sh take --run and derive the roster itself from the Agent Mail registry, so the rule lives in a script rather than in conductor prose.

auto_fix.title: A worker whose Agent Mail registration fails keeps the ac-<ts>-<pid> fallback and drops silently out of the orphan sweep
auto_fix.fix: In a swarm, make registration failure stop the worker: return without claiming instead of continuing on the fallback. Alternatively, have coordinator.sh go red on any in_progress claim whose assignee matches the ac-<ts>-<pid> fallback shape or claimed_at >= run start and that is not in the roster ('UNROSTERED'), so a missing registration surfaces rather than hiding.

auto_fix.title: ac-4y7l.17's landing record cites an amended-away diagnostic commit, and its work shipped under the message 'test' with no cause
auto_fix.fix: Treat the commit stage as a door with one refusing owner. swarm-commit.sh should be the only sanctioned commit path for workers, and a pre-commit hook.d entry should refuse a commit in a swarm (AC2 run env present) that did not come through it. A post-close check should also go red when a WORKER stamp's tree= is not an ancestor of the ledger commit, for example check 35 rule 6 asserting `git merge-base --is-ancestor <tree> HEAD`. Separately, reword fcc88b3's cause into the ledger by commenting on .17 with the real sha. Do not rewrite history.

auto_fix.title: Check 27's shrink-only ratchet was re-seeded to admit a whole-file instance-token exemption, and the humans list lives in portable canon
auto_fix.fix: Move the humans list to per-deployment instance config that the gate reads, for example $ROOT/.beads/humans or an env/infra file resolved by the gate, keyed by consumer repo. Leave bead-conventions.md to state the rule: 'the deployment's humans file names who may rule'. Delete the allowlist file so Check 27 is back to zero entries. If Craig wants the canon literal, record that as a ruling and have the check support a line-scoped entry, never a file-scoped one.

auto_fix.title: Summary-only findings are always counted new, so the pre-existing rescue can never pass a Python file with ruff/bandit findings or truncated details
auto_fix.fix: Compare summary-only overflow against the base: new_overflow = max(0, (HEAD_SUM - HEAD_COUNT) - (BASE_SUM - BASE_COUNT)). Better: parse ruff's JSON (filename + name + message) and bandit's `>> Issue: [Bxxx]` + `Location:` path as signature sources, so fewer findings fall into the unmatched bucket.

auto_fix.title: Test fixture's mock ubs does not match real ubs output, which hid both scanner defects
auto_fix.fix: Make the mock print `$(cd "$(dirname $f)" && pwd)/$(basename $f):$ln` with a ` (https://…#L$ln)` suffix when `git rev-parse` succeeds. Make the summary counters at least the DETAIL count, plus an overflow finding with no DETAIL line. Add one case replaying a captured real ubs transcript.

auto_fix.title: refly.test.sh br mock drops --transition-comment, so 2 cases fail on the committed tree
auto_fix.fix: In the refly mock's close branch, parse `--transition-comment <text>` and append it to $BR_COMMENTS_LOG, mirroring close-gate.test.sh's mock. Add refly.test.sh (and every other suite whose br shim handles `close`) to the probe set of any bead that changes close-gate's write path.

auto_fix.title: Mock summary counters (all 0) contradict its own detail lines; real ubs lists fewer detail lines than it counts, so the SUM_TOTAL>HEAD_COUNT overflow always adds 'new' findings and no case exercises it
auto_fix.fix: Make the mock's summary counters equal what real ubs reports: the count includes findings not listed as detail lines, and python lines have no column. Add a case where the base and HEAD both carry an identical truncated list ('8 found', 5 shown) and assert the gate does not refuse. On the gate side, compare the base summary counters against the HEAD summary counters for the overflow instead of comparing HEAD summary to HEAD detail count.

auto_fix.title: refly.test.sh went red (18/2) when close-gate moved its landing record to --transition-comment; its br stub still ignores that flag
auto_fix.fix: In refly.test.sh's stub `close)` branch, parse `--transition-comment <text>` and append it to "${BR_COMMENTS_LOG:?}", the same way close-gate.test.sh's mock does. Wire refly.test.sh into whatever gate runs close-gate.test.sh so a red sibling harness blocks the commit.

auto_fix.title: Check-35 'identity by id, never position' case stays green when the fix is reverted to positional slicing
auto_fix.fix: Order the staged comments so position and identity disagree. Put the new canon comment BEFORE a legacy malformed one, e.g. staged [id13 (new, canon), id12, id11 (legacy, malformed)]. A positional slice then yields [id11] and false-FAILs, while identity yields [id13] and passes. Assert rc==0.

auto_fix.title: Identity canon still says the conductor reads agent.name from the spawn and that stance children have no mcp tools; SKILL.md cites it for the opposite procedure
auto_fix.fix: Rewrite agent-identity.md lines 39, 76, 138 and 147: the implementer stance child mints its own name and reserves under it; the conductor's roster (and ac-land's) comes from agents registered since the run started, filtered by the run id in task_description.

auto_fix.title: The human-gate-template close example records DECISION (operator), which the new gate refuses
auto_fix.fix: Change the example to `DECISION (Craig): ...` and add one sentence: the actor must be a name taken verbatim from bead-conventions.md's `Humans who rule:` line.

auto_fix.title: Nothing ties the <human> placeholder to the canon line, and the gate strips spaces from the list but not from the actor
auto_fix.fix: Split HUMANS on commas, trim each entry, compare to the trimmed RULING_ACTOR keeping inner spaces. State in action-loop.md and bead-conventions.md that <human> is copied verbatim from `Humans who rule:`. Add cases for `DECISION (Craig van Heerden): ...` and a comma-plus-space canon list.

auto_fix.title: ac-tidy exemption never checks the ruling says 'moot', and it keys on labels any agent can add at close time
auto_fix.fix: Require the ac-tidy ruling to match exactly: `[ "$RULING" = 'DECISION (ac-tidy): moot' ]` (allowing only an optional ' — <why>' suffix). Take the routing type/labels and the pipeline-proposal label from the COMMITTED board (`git show HEAD:.beads/issues.jsonl`) rather than the live row, so a label added during the session cannot move a bead onto the no-probe path. Add a test where `DECISION (ac-tidy): approved` must be refused.

auto_fix.title: Ruling matcher judges only the FIRST DECISION comment, so an earlier unauthorized ruling blocks a later valid human one; the canon's own worked example is refused
auto_fix.fix: Evaluate every first-line ruling and accept the LATEST authorised one; refuse only when none is authorised. Compare actors case-insensitively. Change the human-gate-template example to 'DECISION (<human>)' and add a pointer to the Humans line. Reword the 'DECISION (agent)' sites so they record on the consuming bead, never on a decision or human-gate bead, or rename that token (for example 'AGENT-CHOICE:') so it cannot be confused with a ruling. Add a test case: an unauthorised ruling followed by a Craig ruling closes.

auto_fix.title: The base scan runs in a scratch dir without the repo's ruff.toml, so base and HEAD are scanned under different rule sets
auto_fix.fix: Copy the root lint configs (ruff.toml, pyproject.toml, .ubsignore, etc.) from BASE_TREE into SCRATCH before scanning. Or scan the base in a `git worktree add --detach` of BASE_TREE, which also gives both runs the same URL/path shape.

auto_fix.title: An earlier unauthorized DECISION line permanently masks a later valid human ruling
auto_fix.fix: Loop over all first-line DECISION candidates and accept the first authorized one. Name the rejected actor(s) in CLOSE-REFUSED DECISION. Change the human-gate-template.md example to `DECISION (Craig): …`.

auto_fix.title: The gate checks only the FIRST DECISION line, so an earlier unauthorized or superseded ruling blocks or overrides a later valid one
auto_fix.fix: Iterate every first-line match and take the LAST authorized one. Add tests for [agent then Craig] (closes) and [Craig A then Craig B] (record cites B).

auto_fix.title: The ac-tidy exception is documented as the literal 'moot' but accepts any ac-tidy ruling text
auto_fix.fix: Require `^DECISION \(ac-tidy\): moot( |$)` for the ac-tidy branch; add a refuse test for a non-moot ac-tidy ruling.

deferred.title: Any genuine human DECISION ever posted becomes close authority after a live relabel or reopen (retype bypass without forgery)
deferred.fix: Take the routing type/labels from the committed HEAD board, not the live row, so a retype or relabel in the same session cannot route. Accept only a ruling comment created after the bead's most recent status transition to open/in_progress (compare its created_at against the latest reopen event, or against HEAD's board snapshot, the same by-identity 'new since HEAD' logic rule 6 uses). Add tests: (a) a task bead relabelled human-gate mid-session carrying an old Craig ruling must be refused; (b) a reopened decision bead with only its pre-reopen ruling must be refused.

deferred.title: Scanner baseline tree comes from an unauthenticated receipt file, is read even when LEG 1 rejected that receipt, and is never checked to predate the bead's work; inert today only because real ubs prints absolute paths
deferred.fix: (1) Use BASE_TREE only when FRESH_VERIFY=0, meaning the receipt is the one LEG 1 accepted. (2) Require `git merge-base --is-ancestor $BASE_TREE HEAD` and `$BASE_TREE != $(git rev-parse HEAD)`. Better still, require it to equal the tree on the receipt comment posted to the bead at claim time, which is board state rather than a local file. (3) Remove the $ROOT/ and $SCRATCH/ prefixes from the path before building the signature. (4) Match as a multiset: count occurrences of each signature at HEAD and at base, and count max(0, head-base) as new. (5) Add a test with a real ubs-shaped absolute-path fixture, and a test where a receipt `tree:` equal to HEAD must NOT rescue anything.

deferred.title: Base-tree ubs scan runs even when summary-only findings already make refusal certain
deferred.fix: Compute SUM_TOTAL and HEAD_COUNT before the BASE_USABLE block. If SUM_TOTAL > HEAD_COUNT, refuse straight away (or skip the base scan) instead of building the scratch tree and running ubs a second time.

deferred.title: New label lookup fetches the same bead with br show again, right after br_field did
deferred.fix: Read the bead once: SHOW_JSON=$(br_call show "$BEAD" --json) || not_checked ...; then take issue_type and labels with a single jq call (e.g. jq -r '[.issue_type, ((.labels//[])|join(","))]|@tsv'). Reuse SHOW_JSON for description, status and assignee until the write at line 724 (only the post-write status read needs a fresh fetch).

deferred.title: Consumer-first path resolution is copied into four prose fences in a different order from the gate, and the 'fenced once' idiom is now fenced twice
deferred.fix: Add one resolver owned by _tools, for example `skills/_tools/resolve.sh <relpath>`, that prints the first existing path among .claude/skills, skills and .agents/skills, or exits non-zero naming all three. Have close-gate.sh and every prose fence call it. In human-gate-template.md, replace the duplicated fence with the pointer it already claims to use.

deferred.title: Set-membership match rescues a newly added duplicate finding
deferred.fix: Match as a multiset: count occurrences per sig in base and at HEAD, and count max(0, head_n - base_n) as new. For example: `sort | uniq -c` both sides, then join.

deferred.title: The implementer's new tool list cannot carry out worker.md's renew, re-list and message steps
deferred.fix: Add renew_file_reservations and send_message (plus a listing tool) to the implementer tools, or cut §5b to what the stance can do.
